scripts.migrate:dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development npx sequelize-cli db:migrate --env development --migrations-path migrations --config config/config.cjs
scripts.migrate:dev:undo: cross-env NODE_ENV=development npx sequelize-cli db:migrate:undo:all --env development --migrations-path migrations --config config/config.cjs
scripts.migrate:dev:status: cross-env NODE_ENV=development npx sequelize-cli db:migrate:status --env development --migrations-path migrations --config config/config.cjs
scripts.seed:dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development npx sequelize-cli db:seed:all --env development --seeders-path seeders --config config/config.cjs
scripts.seed:dev:undo: cross-env NODE_ENV=development npx sequelize-cli db:seed:undo:all --seeders-path seeders --env development --config config/config.cjs
scripts.fresh:dev: echo First remove type module from package.json && npm run seed:dev:undo && npm run migrate:dev:undo && npm run migrate:dev && npm run seed:dev
